notes: Agent hit 429 rate limit without making any changes to the repository.
Anti-pattern scan (eval 4): with_skill achieves 5/5 despite rate limit, while without_skill only fixes 2/5 and fails to commit. +60% improvement.
i18n sync (eval 5): Both configurations hit 429 after syncing JSON keys (2/5). Neither fixed conditional bilingual rendering. Skill provides no advantage here under rate-limited conditions.
Performance audit (eval 6): with_skill partially fixes images (1/5) before API error; without_skill makes zero changes (0/5). Skill provides some advantage but both fail on deps and commit.
Rate limits severely impacted this iteration. 5 of 6 agents hit 429/API errors before completing. Token metrics unavailable due to errors.
Commit discipline remains the biggest gap: only 1 of 6 runs committed successfully (eval 4 with_skill).
